L-001.subject: Carrier selection at Brightlane
L-001.body:
Hi Anna,

Thanks for reaching out. Routing 4k parcels a day by hand is a lot of decisions, and carrier selection is usually the first thing teams automate. I'd like to understand how Brightlane picks a carrier today and where it slows you down.

Would a call on Tuesday or Wednesday work?

Best,
Mateo R.

L-003.subject: Demo for the Tallyfold RevOps team
L-003.body:
Hi Tom,

Happy to set up a demo for your RevOps team this month. If you send me the two or three questions that matter most to Tallyfold, I'll shape the session around them instead of a generic tour.

Does Thursday afternoon UK time suit?

Best,
Mateo R.

L-004.subject: Good to meet you at SaaStock
L-004.body:
Hi Priyanka,

Great to meet you at the SaaStock booth, and thanks for checking pricing afterwards. Before I send anything, it would help to know how OrbitCrate routes inbound leads today and who owns follow-up.

Could we do a short call this week?

Best,
Mateo R.

L-007.subject: Kestrel Health vendor evaluation
L-007.body:
Hi Dana,

Thanks for including us in your Q1 evaluation. Teams like Kestrel Health usually cut lead response time by 35% in the first month with us.

Would a demo next week help your shortlist?

Best,
Jordan T.

L-008.subject: Fennick & Co and lead routing
L-008.body:
Hi Liam,

Thanks for your note. With a team of 12 people at Fennick & Co, the setup can stay simple: one form, one scoring rule, and a shared queue. I can show you what that looks like.

Would a quick call next week work?

Best,
Amira H.

L-009.subject: Following up for Marrowsoft
L-009.body:
Hi Grace,

Good to hear from you again. I look after the Marrowsoft account, so I can pick this up directly. What would be most useful for your sales operations team right now?

Happy to find a time this week.

Best,
Amira H.

L-011.subject: Dunmore Freight and the webinar
L-011.body:
Hi Marcus,

Thanks for joining the webinar. Operations teams at freight companies like Dunmore Freight often ask how routing works when territories overlap. I'd be glad to walk you through it with your own setup in mind.

Would a call next week suit you?

Best,
Priya S.

L-013.subject: Cobalt Rail
L-013.body:
Hi Jonas,

Thanks for your interest. As head of IT at Cobalt Rail you probably care most about how this connects to your existing systems, so I'd start there. I can share the integration overview before we talk.

Would that be useful?

Best,
Luka P.

L-014.subject: Routing by account tier at Pebbleworks
L-014.body:
Hi Ella,

Routing by account tier is a good fit: Pebbleworks can send enterprise accounts to named owners and everyone else to a shared queue, with the rules in one place. I can show you both paths in a demo.

Does Monday or Tuesday work?

Best,
Jordan T.

L-015.subject: Harborline Shipping
L-015.body:
Hi Pieter,

Thanks for looking at our pricing. Before I suggest a plan for Harborline Shipping, could you tell me roughly how many leads your team handles in a month and which CRM you use?

Then I can point you to the right option.

Best,
Amira H.

L-016.subject: Salesforce integration for Sablemint
L-016.body:
Hi Noah,

Yes, we integrate with Salesforce, and leads land with the owner, score and reasons on the record. Sign this month and I can get Sablemint a 20% discount on the first year.

Want to see it live?

Best,
Priya S.

L-018.subject: Lead routing for your 3 SDRs
L-018.body:
Hi Erik,

With 3 SDRs, ArcPipe can split leads by territory and load so nobody gets swamped and nothing waits. I'd like to show you how the rules look and how you'd change them yourself.

Could we book a demo this week?

Best,
Luka P.

L-021.subject: Replacing the manual lead process at Glasswing
L-021.body:
Hi Oliver,

Thanks for the demo request. Replacing a manual lead process is exactly where this helps most at a company like Glasswing Payments. I'd like to hear which steps take your team the longest today.

Does Wednesday work for a demo?

Best,
Amira H.

L-024.subject: Tallyfold and the webinar
L-024.body:
Hi Ben,

Thanks for joining the webinar. I'm already talking to your colleague Tom about a demo for Tallyfold, so it might make sense to join that session. Shall I add you?

Best,
Mateo R.

L-026.subject: Comparing plans for Marrowsoft
L-026.body:
Hi Jamal,

I look after the Marrowsoft account, so I can help you compare plans directly. Which matters more for your team right now: the number of seats or the integrations?

Happy to talk this week.

Best,
Amira H.

L-028.subject: ArcPipe and lead routing
L-028.body:
Hi Ingrid,

Thanks for checking our pricing. I'm also speaking with Erik about routing for ArcPipe, so I can share the same setup with you and answer any sales questions.

Would a joint call be helpful?

Best,
Luka P.
